vulnerability_analysis: The WBTC contract inherits from Claimable, which has a vulnerable ownership transfer mechanism. The transferOwnership() function allows setting any address as pendingOwner without validation. An attacker can call transferOwnership(attacker) followed by claimOwnership() to become the owner, then mint unlimited WBTC tokens to themselves.
attack_strategy: Exploit the Claimable contract's ownership transfer vulnerability to become the owner, then mint WBTC tokens to increase attacker balance.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Check if contract is paused (shouldn't be for minting). 2. Call transferOwnership(attacker) to set attacker as pending owner. 3. Call claimOwnership() to become the new owner. 4. Call mint(attacker, largeAmount) to mint WBTC tokens. 5. Verify attacker's WBTC balance increased.
